messages:
nina-s: Heads-up: after the RBAC rollout some tenants saw mass SCIM deprovisions and SSO failures. Quick look shows saml binding mismatches and a few wrapped-token lookups failing in token-store.

ben-t: Seeing same. auth-proxy logs:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: saml: binding mismatch expected=HTTP-POST got=HTTP-Artifact tenant=orbital
WARN token-store: unwrap failed alias=wrap_v2 keyid=old-enc-01 err=WRAP_KEY_NOT_FOUND
WARN scim-worker: deprov enqueue tenant=orbital svc_acc=sa-ingest cause=auth_failed
```

hiro-o: Two parallel issues likely: (1) IdP metadata switched to Artifact-only for some customers; (2) KMS alias wrap_v2 rotated earlier and some tokens still reference the old alias which token-store can't unwrap -> partial auth failures. Also noticed audit-shipper shows a small gap coincident with the rotation.

nina-s: Quick mitigation we can do: enable tenant-scoped artifact fallback in auth-proxy (whitelist affected tenants), requeue SCIM deprovs after we confirm auth, and backfill audit events for the gap window. Also run a redis scan to find token:wrap references to old alias.

ben-t: Commands I'm running now:
```
curl -s https://auth-proxy.internal/.well-known/saml-metadata | xmllint --xpath "//Binding/text()" -
kubectl exec -n infra deploy/token-store -- redis-cli --scan | grep wrap_v1
./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant orbital --since 1746499000
```

hiro-o: I'll check KMS logs for recent rekey events and list aliases. If we find stale aliases referenced by wrapped tokens, we'll schedule an unwrap/rewrap (unwrap with old key, rewrap with new alias) before forcing a rotation of consumers.

oncall: Opening incident INC-174650. Running backfill: `./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1746498800 --end 1746500200` and coordinating customer comms.

ops-bot: auth-proxy hotfix 2024.11.3 queued; will enable per-tenant artifact fallback flag during canary.

nina-s: Owners: Ben=auth-proxy temporary toggle + canary, Hiro=KMS/unwrap sweep + token-store audit, Nina=SCIM requeue & audit backfill, Oncall=customer comms + incident timeline. Please paste results and any redis dump lines referencing wrap aliases. We'll reconvene when canary healthy and requeues complete. :thumbsup:
